findings.issue: `lift` (64-67), `lift_mk` (74, proved by `(rfl)`) and `ind` (80) apply `Quotient.lift`/`Quotient.ind` at type `LineBundleClass X`, which typechecks only by unfolding `LineBundleClass → Skeleton → InducedCategory → Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid _)`; `e.some` additionally unfolds `Setoid.r → IsIsomorphic → Nonempty`. No comment documents any of this, and Mathlib exposes no quotient API for `Skeleton` — the quotient presentation is an implementation detail of the type synonym.

summary: The new `lift`/`lift_mk`/`ind` eliminators are built by unfolding `LineBundleClass → Skeleton → InducedCategory → Quotient` and `≈ → IsIsomorphic → Nonempty`, undocumented defeq through type synonyms that the repo elsewhere avoids via the public skeleton API.
